description: B_obs/|tr_M| across D,T,³He under the canonical Markov trace (include_inter=True). Tests whether the Path-3 single-prefactor binding model B=α_M·|tr_M| has a FORCED universal α_M (= m_e·ρ_binding, constant). Finding: the ratio varies ~182% (D 5.73, T 81.5, ³He 37.4), so α_M is NOT a forced constant — the model is a deuteron-anchored approximation that fails at A=3. Scope (a): tr_M as an ingredient is NOT excluded; only the constant-prefactor assumption is refuted. The D ratio 5.728 reproduces the published α_M 5.729 (cross-validates the pipeline).
name: rho-binding-constancy
